ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area (~92%) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters limited to the distal tip margins and foam-filled water background at the fluke base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black contiguous mapping across the majority of both lobes; distinct high-contrast white/light-grey circular blobs are localized exclusively at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 38 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 12 pixels along the entire continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margin, tapering into rounded, heavily textured distal tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, roughly circular high-contrast pixel groupings (consistent with barnacle colonization) detected at the far-left and far-right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, approximately 1/3 of the way from the notch to the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and associated scarring localized at the peripheral margins of the fluke tips; no major amputations or trauma visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge morphology, with a secondary U-shaped indentation located on the left lobe approximately mid-span.
